planets.name: TOI-5811 B b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-5811 B with a 6.26-day year, found in 2026.

text.card: TOI-5811 B b was found in 2026 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-5811 B. Its orbit and size follow Lillo-Box et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
